title: observability-token-kv-metrics-tracing-dashboard-alert-tuning-enhancements
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: reduce alert noise and improve root-cause visibility for token-level cost/latency and KV cache behavior. This PR adds token-level KV cache metrics, integrates tracing spans for KV hits/misses, ships a Grafana dashboard focused on token cost/latency breakdowns, and tunes alert thresholds to match observed production distributions. Summary of changes: - Add Prometheus metrics: redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_cache_hit_ratio, redwood_token_cost_per_request, redwood_token_latency_ms (histogram), redwood_token_latency_bucketed_ms. - Emit KV-related tracing spans in the serving runtime: span tags include model_id, route, cache_key, hit/miss. - Dashboard: new Grafana dashboard (dashboards/token-kv-cost-latency.json) with panels for token cost breakdown (model vs quantization vs infra), per-route latency P50/P90/P99, KV hit ratio heatmap, and per-client cost burn rate. - Alerts: adjusted alert rules in prometheus/rules/token-kv-alerts.yaml. Key changes: 1) Increased latency alert windows from 1m to 5m for P99 to reduce flapping during short bursts. 2) Introduced "token cost burn" anomaly alert with rate-limited notifications. 3) Suppressed KV-miss-alerts for known migration windows via temporary labels. - Tests: unit tests for metric registration and end-to-end smoke test for dashboard panels rendering in staging. Commits: - 7f2a1b2 Add KV metrics and metric registry helpers - e4b3c8d Instrument serving runtime with KV tracing spans - 9a1d4ff Add Grafana dashboard JSON and template variables - d2c9b3a Tune Prometheus alert rules and add tests - 1b7f6e0 Fix linting and histogram bucket config Files changed (high-level): - runtime/kv_metrics.go (metric counters + histograms) - runtime/tracing/hooks.go (emit KV spans) - infra/observability/dashboards/token-kv-cost-latency.json (Grafana) - infra/observability/prometheus/token-kv-alerts.yaml - tests/observability/test_kv_metrics.py - docs/observability/token_kv_metrics.md - charts/monitoring/values.yaml (dashboard enable flag) CI: initial pipeline failed lint (histogram bucket format) and a flaky dashboard rendering check; both fixed in follow-up commits and CI passed on the final push. Review thread (condensed): - Avery Chen: "Can we add finer histogram buckets around 0-50ms for short-tail LLMs and ensure histograms use exponential buckets? Also please add an enum for cache outcome to avoid stringly-typed tags." - Author (Maya): "Added buckets and updated the tag to an enum (CacheHit/CacheMiss/Bypass). PTAL." - Riley Patel: "Alert thresholds look reasonable but please add runbook snippets to the alert rule to reduce on-call triage time." - Author: "Added runbook links and a short triage checklist in the alert comment." - Samir Gupta: "Approve after CI passes and a unit test for metric registration is added." - Author: "Added test and fixed lint failures; CI green." Merge: squash and merge. Notes: Backwards compatible metric names preserved; new metrics are additive. Dashboard is optional behind monitoring.enable_token_kv_dashboard feature flag. Linear/Jira: ENG-8412 (observability/token-kv-metrics), ENG-8479 (dashboard/alert-tuning), SUP-9123 (customer-reported high-cost alerts).
release_notes: Add token-level KV metrics, tracing spans for KV hit/miss, new Grafana dashboard for token cost/latency, and tuned alert rules to reduce noise.
